No results. Perhaps the product SMILES is wrong. Maybe the product is simply the aryl chloride plus the acyl chloride (with Cl) combined? Actually Friedel-Crafts acylation product would be COc1cccc(C(=O)R)c1 where R is the acyl group from second precursor but second precursor is not acyl chloride. Could be that the second precursor is actually the acyl chloride after removing Cl? Wait second precursor has NC(=O) attached to heterocycle; maybe the acyl group is -C(=O)N- heterocycle, which is an amide, not typical.

Maybe the template is a generic C–Cl bond cleavage and C–C bond formation, not necessarily ketone. Could be functional_groups_formed "C-C single bond". Not in list. Could be "C-C double bonds"? Not.

Maybe we should search without functional groups but with bonds criteria only. Provide empty lists for functional groups.
